name: ensoniqplayau
description: ensoniqplay AU support: play a mu-law .au (bell.au, 8000 Hz, ~1.6s) then a 16-bit big-endian .au (tone16.au, 22050 Hz, 1.0s), both baked at /root/audio.  'au mu-law' and 'au 16-bit signed' prove the AU header parse + encodings; the halts prove the decoded samples play at the right rate.  Baked in disk_src/root/audio (not staged).
